stem: One genotype establishes well while another performs poorly under the same medium and operator. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Genotype response should be treated as a plausible factor and evaluated rather than pooled away
The operator must be at fault
One result proves a universal medium failure
All genotypes should be expected to respond identically
rationale: Genotype-by-treatment interactions are common enough that establishment outcomes should be analyzed by genotype.
